authorization: After PHY-002 was frozen, the operator explicitly requested creative theoretical construction in addition to literature review. This supplement records prospective designs, not permission to change P1/PAH or claim a successful physical model.
selection_principle: Creative hypotheses may supply new premises, but must be labeled new and face an inexpensive rejecting test. Prior theorems constrain design; their conclusions do not automatically survive added interactions.

preferred_design.title: Closed internal-conversion parent for a phase-control quantity
preferred_design.intuition: The order-forming sector can acquire population from other degrees of freedom of one closed system rather than from an imposed cosmic chemical potential. This is a proposed internal conversion, not creation from nothing.
preferred_design.role: Prospective phase-control supplier with the highest direct connection to R158's missing input; NOT yet a pregeometric origin model.
preferred_design.unchanged_component: Retain original F_P1[Psi] as a named static component. Preserve Q_P1=||Psi||^2/2 and all its existing theorem boundaries.
new_hypotheses: Add a complex internal-reservoir coordinate chi of twice the global U(1) weight of Psi; this is new, not present in the P1 source.
Use one autonomous Hamiltonian evolution parameter tau and explicitly chosen symplectic brackets; tau is not identified with proper, Lorentzian or A2 gradient time.
Specify a stable reservoir energy and pair-conversion interaction. Their physical origin, units, parameter values, domain and state preparation remain unproved.
The current field version still assumes the original fixed spatial torus. It is not a derivation of spatial dimension or geometry.
preferred_design.illustrative_equation_NOT_ADOPTED: H_trial=F_P1[Psi]+integral (omega*|chi|^2/2+u*|chi|^4/4)-epsilon*Re integral conjugate(chi)*sum_a Psi_a^2; u>0. Proposed brackets {Psi_a,conjugate(Psi_b)}=-2i delta_ab delta and {chi,conjugate(chi)}=-2i delta. Proposed Q_total=Q_P1+2*Q_chi, Q_chi=||chi||^2/2.
preferred_design.required_first_test: Verify one consistent bracket/sign/domain convention gives both total-charge conservation and genuine inter-sector transfer. Then compare the full coupled zero-phase Hessian with the R158 ensemble Hessian. No fitted mu(t), counterterm cancellation or selected trajectory is allowed.
hostile_design_objections: A density-only coupling may preserve separate phase symmetries and hence fail to transfer population at all. Conservation alone is not the required mechanism.
Pair conversion is quadratic in Psi around chi0 nonzero; its phase-sensitive Hessian contribution must be included. It cannot be assumed to be the scalar term -mu*Q or to preserve R158 coexistence.
The classical exactly-zero Psi subspace may remain invariant. A seed, fluctuation state or quantum completion must be specified independently, not added after failure.
Eliminating chi need not produce an autonomous, memoryless Psi law. R577's state-sufficiency lesson forbids silently deleting reservoir memory.

A stable full parent, an effective-state reduction and uniform remainder estimates are not supplied by this sketch. The displayed term must also be checked against every symmetry actually required of the target.
preferred_design.falsifier: If genuine transfer requires a load-bearing perturbation outside the preserved P1 phase mechanism, or the same parent cannot supply a justified state/reduction with controlled remainder, reject this proposed R158 realization rather than tuning away the obstruction.
preferred_design.reuse: R157/R158 exact internal constraints; potential conditional reuse of the unchanged static component only after a controlled reduction. A2/A3 dynamics and A6/A7 Gaussian composites are NOT inherited.
preferred_design.missing_before_model_admission: Fixed carrier/domain/regulator, all units and coefficients, physical state and symmetry choices, interpretation of internal reservoir and time, and a source or explicitly approved hypothesis for each addition.

alternative_design.title: Space-like network order and matter-like defects from one rewiring system
alternative_design.intuition: Treat persistent connectivity order and mobile defects as different collective descriptions of the same microscopic graph variables, rather than equating space, energy and mass as identical quantities.
alternative_design.illustrative_rule_NOT_ADOPTED: At fixed finite N, use connected simple 6-regular graph basis states with counting measure, vertex-relabeling group averaging, and valid length-3-path edge swaps (ab,cd)<->(ac,bd). A trial H=t*B_star*B-J*C4 rewards square loops while allowing rewiring. Ground-state projector is the proposed state; its uniqueness is not assumed.
alternative_design.inputs_not_emergence: Fixed N, degree six, allowed rewiring, state selection, t,J and external quantum evolution parameter are inputs. Degree six does not prove three-dimensional space. Uniform orbit weighting must not replace inherited counting measure.
alternative_design.first_falsifier: Before any large simulation, compare the full kinetic-plus-cycle variational energy of extended cubic-like graphs with connected dense square-rich blocks at the same N and valence. If clustering wins, do not add rescuing penalties after inspection.
alternative_design.physical_target: Only later test nondegenerate mesoscopic dimension/locality and mobile long-lived finite-excess-energy defects under the SAME law. Neither adjacency, cycle count nor vertex count is physical distance, mass or P1 charge by definition.
alternative_design.reuse: PAH incidence/projection/counting audit methods only. No direct R158, A2/A3, A6/A7 or Reading-H theorem inheritance.
alternative_design.priority_reason: Closer to the space/matter common-substrate intuition, but much weaker reuse and an early clustering risk. Preserve as a reserve idea, not a competing open-ended simulation lane.

review.primary: Root constrained the proposal with fixed P1/R158 scope, PAH state sufficiency and no physical-time identification.
review.independent_design: phy002_internal_constraints examined internal pair conversion; phy002_reuse_matrix proposed and criticized the distinct rewiring design. Same AI collaboration, not an external human referee.
review.executed_verification: NONE for these sketches. No new finite carrier computation, Lean theorem, source-owned realization or numerical claim. The PHY002 diagnostic runs apply to their own frozen source only, not these designs.
review.novelty: No priority or originality claim for pair-conversion or graph-order ingredients. The prospective contribution is their explicitly tested relation to TECT's current missing inputs.

next_single_question: Can one explicitly admitted closed-conversion parent provide genuine population transfer while yielding the R158 static ensemble with a controlled, phase-compatible correction, without externally fitted mu(t)?
reentry: Separate versioned minimum-model admission and a single symmetry/exchange/Hessian audit. Stop the attempted identification on its first failed condition; do not silently repair the model or start an automatic proof chain.
non_claims: No adopted new physical candidate or model, closed gate, proven exchange/Hessian theorem in this record, physical Pre-A, generated spacetime, gravity, QFT, continuum, mass gap or TOE. No energy-from-nothing, black-hole timelessness or outside-universe equivalence.
